items.title: Bob Kinkel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 31, 2012
items.q: So we had ... Jon Anderson from Yes. ... I was talking to Jon and I said, “what was that you did?”

ctx.x: I mean if you said now, if you told them about going on tour with the Who, etcetera, does that impress them?

No. Because they’ve seen me at the high level, and the last eight years or so we’ve been having guests. So we had Roger Daltry on stage, and we did “Behind Blue Eyes” and a few Who hits. And so we’ve had all the big rock stars that have been around with that. So it kind of came full circle. I remember working with Greg Lake from Emerson, Lake & Palmer. He was one of the first special guests we had, along with Jon Anderson from Yes. So like in one year I had to do “Roundabout” live from Yes, which had never really…
